author: Apple
description:
The new Apple HomeView is designed for life at home, with privacy built in to keep personal data private — for everyone who uses it. HomeView recognizes up to six people, delivering a personalized experience for each one. Siri Al, a more powerful personal assistant, carries natural conversations, answers questions, and helps you get things done. FaceTime delivers crystal-clear hands-free video calls and keeps everybody perfectly framed even as they move around. Enjoy music, podcasts, audiobooks, and TV shows with powerful speakers that deliver rich, room-filling Spatial Audio. The 7-inch Liquid Retina display features a customizable collection of fun and helpful faces. And you can control your smart home accessories to see who’s at the door, adjust the lights, manage automations, and more, right from the HomeView smart display.

Learn more and shop Apple HomeView: https://apple.co/4s4jhly

author: Apple
description:
Apple TV 4K delivers the ultimate cinematic experience with 4K picture in Dolby Vision and HDR10+. The new, more powerful Siri AI makes it easier than ever to find and enjoy what you want to watch, listen to, or play. Thanks to built-in far-field microphones you can talk directly to Apple TV 4K from across the room using just your voice. And if your Siri Remote goes missing, use Find My to have it play a sound. Pair Apple TV 4K with four HomePod speakers for home theater surround sound. Enjoy Apple TV, Photos, Apple Fitness+, Apple Music, Apple Arcade, and fun-filled screen savers on your biggest screen. And use Apple TV 4K as a home hub to control your smart home accessories.

Learn more and shop Apple TV 4K: https://apple.co/4e6jcYI 


Dolby Vision and HDR10+ - Works with compatible content in supported apps on compatible devices. Not all content is available in 4K, HDR, HDR10, HDR10+, or Dolby Vision. Playback quality will depend on hardware and internet connection.

description:
The new Apple HomeView is designed to help you stay connected, entertained, and in the know. Built-in speakers with Spatial Audio fill the room with your favorite music, audiobooks, podcasts, and more. Control your smart home right from the smart display with just a few taps or by simply using your voice — HomeView is hands-free when you need it. Send a message, make a call using FaceTime, so you can stay connected with friends and family. Ask Siri AI to help you find what you need and get things done, from managing your schedule and setting reminders to learning something new. Apple HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. With the privacy every home and everyone deserves.

Learn more about Apple HomeView: https://apple.co/3TQsxx5
